biggest_gap.title: Contacts cannot be imported, given custom fields or given attachments, so 2 of the 5 comparison tasks the spec names cannot be done at all
biggest_gap.detail: The spec says contacts is the reference consumer of the shared custom-field, attachment, import and export mechanisms. The product has no custom-field, attachment or import module. The contact form offers only Print, History, Archive, Save and Close, and the list offers Print or export but no import. A UAE trading company's first step is to bring in its existing customers and suppliers (thousands of rows from Excel) and add fields of its own (licence expiry, account manager). Odoo does both: import-5000 in 7 steps, a contact property plus filter in 17 steps. Ours cannot do either, so the piece cannot beat Odoo on two named bar tasks whatever else it wins. Also inside the piece: create-contact loses on keystrokes (70 against 67), and contact codes are typed by hand rather than taken from document numbering (p10), which the spec also lists. The verdict is BLOCKED, separately, by one failing e2e test outside this piece (p12 job cancel).
biggest_gap.evidence: src/Modules holds Audit, Contacts, Currency, Identity, Jobs, Lists, Numbering, Reports and Tenancy, with no CustomFields, Attachments or Import module. gauntlet/compare/drivers/ours/custom-field-filter.mjs and import-5000.mjs are stubs ('not built yet: waits for p09/p14 with p16'). Screenshot 02 shows the record header buttons. ContactsModule.cs line 60 says numbering 'will offer the next one'. compare/results/create-contact-*.json shows ours 8 steps / 70 keys against Odoo 9 / 67.

other_findings: [route: p12-jobs] Failing e2e test that blocks the round: tests/e2e/specs/jobs.spec.ts:65 'a running job shows its progress and is cancelled from the panel'. After the Cancel click the panel stayed Running, then showed Done; Cancelled never appeared (verify-kept/e2e.log). The load was low (under 1.5). I could not reproduce it on the demo: 3 API cancels and 3 UI cancels each reached 'cancelled' within 2 s (job-cancel-api-repro.txt, job-cancel-ui-repro.txt). This suggests an intermittent race between the Cancel click and the live-updating panel, or a worker that misses a cancel. The toolbox kept no Playwright trace.

The contacts list's default 'Standard' view shows archived contacts mixed with active ones: the API default total is 100,019, of which 13 are archived. An 'Active' preset exists, but Odoo hides archived contacts by default.

A credit limit in a foreign currency needs its exchange rate typed by hand (the server answers contactsRateRequired). The form does not offer the workspace's own rate from the currency module, which holds 100,000 rates. The currency suggestions are a fixed list in code.
Arabic: the duplicate warning joins its reasons with a Latin comma ('الاسم نفسه, البريد نفسه') instead of the Arabic comma '،'.
The contact code (reference) is typed by hand. Document numbering (p10) is integrated but not used for contacts, although the spec lists numbering among the shared mechanisms contacts builds on.

Ratchet: my run used 15,660 s of processor time (dotnet 13,106, web 2,224, e2e 330), with load 0.5 to 3 for most of the run. The gate test process reached about 20 GB RSS and swapped, so the dotnet stage took 2.6 h wall. Within the 16,000 s maximum.
